# Write the m2 fix script
import base64

script = b'''import re

with open("markdown/extensions/toc.py", "r") as f:
    content = f.read()

# Replace the old run method with the new one
old_run_start = "    def run(self, doc: etree.Element) -> None:"
old_run_end = "        self.md.toc = toc\\n"

start_idx = content.find(old_run_start)
end_idx = content.find(old_run_end, start_idx) + len(old_run_end)

new_run = '''    def run(self, doc: etree.Element) -> None:
        # Get a list of id attributes
        used_ids = set()
        for el in doc.iter():
            if "id" in el.attrib:
                used_ids.add(el.attrib["id"])

        toc_tokens = []
        for el in doc.iter():
            if isinstance(el.tag, str) and self.header_rgx.match(el.tag):
                self.set_level(el)

                # Use render_inner_html + run_postprocessors + striptags
                # instead of get_name/stashedHTML2text
                inner_html = render_inner_html(self.md, el)
                processed = run_postprocessors(self.md, inner_html)
                text = striptags(processed)

                # Do not override pre-existing ids
                if "id" not in el.attrib:
                    innertext = html.unescape(text)
                    el.attrib["id"] = unique(self.slugify(innertext, self.sep), used_ids)

                if int(el.tag[-1]) >= self.toc_top and int(el.tag[-1]) <= self.toc_bottom:
                    toc_tokens.append({
                        'level': int(el.tag[-1]),
                        'id': el.attrib["id"],
                        'name': text
                    })

                # Remove the data-toc-label attribute as it is no longer needed
                if 'data-toc-label' in el.attrib:
                    del el.attrib['data-toc-label']

                if self.use_anchors:
                    self.add_anchor(el, el.attrib["id"])
                if self.use_permalinks not in [False, None]:
                    self.add_permalink(el, el.attrib["id"])

        toc_tokens = nest_toc_tokens(toc_tokens)
        div = self.build_toc_div(toc_tokens)
        if self.marker:
            self.replace_marker(doc, div)

        # serialize and attach to markdown instance.
        toc = self.md.serializer(div)
        for pp in self.md.postprocessors:
            toc = pp.run(toc)
        self.md.toc_tokens = toc_tokens
        self.md.toc = toc
'''

content = content[:start_idx] + new_run + content[end_idx:]

with open("markdown/extensions/toc.py", "w") as f:
    f.write(content)
print("SUCCESS")
'''

encoded = base64.b64encode(script).decode()
r = await world.call('repo.shell', command=f'echo {encoded} | base64 -d > /tmp/fix_m2.py && python3 /tmp/fix_m2.py')
print(r['content'])
